'''Padmé's office''' was located just above a landing platform in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]. It was from this office that she worked, drafting legislation and signing documents.

==History==
[[File:Anakin_hiding_under_desk.png|thumb|left|200px|Anakin hides under Padmé's desk.]]

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] often used her office as a secret meeting place during daylight hours to avoid their secret [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] from being discovered. They were both there just prior to [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|taking a group]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senators]], including Amidala herself, hostage. However, they were interrupted by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] as they were sharing a tender embrace, forcing Skywalker to hide under the desk.

During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], Padmé came to her office to gather important paperwork, even though the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was under attack.
